note: Watches applied to new approaches to market. A watch fires only for a notice first seen after the watch existed, so adding one here does not replay the archive into the alert feed. Every condition a watch states must hold; a watch that states nothing matches nothing. Terms are case-insensitive substrings of the ATM id, title, description, agency, category and type.

fields.name: label shown on the alert
fields.any: fires if ANY of these terms appears
fields.all: every one of these terms must appear
fields.none: suppresses the match if any of these appears
fields.multi_agency: Yes or No — open to multiple agencies

watches.name: Panel arrangements open to every agency
